svg.title: Two positions of a 3×3 kernel on a 4×4 input
svg.desc: Kernel rows 1 0 -1, 2 0 -2, 1 0 -1. Position 1 covers columns 1 to 3 and gives 1 - 6 + 1 = -4. Position 2 slides one column right and gives 1 - 2 + 0 = -1. The 2×2 output is -4, -1 on top and 0, 0 below.
svg.text: The same 9 weights are used at every position.
Sliding down one row gives the bottom two cells, 0 and 0, for the final output [[−4, −1], [0, 0]].
